questions.question: Which North Station pumps kept running during the four-hour power cut of 17 November 2024?

chunks.quote: The only stoppage was a four-hour power cut on 17 November, when both pumps were off.

questions.note: None: the 2024 summary says both pumps were off during the power cut. HP40-1183, kept on duty for most of 2024, is the tempting answer, but the duty share does not cover the stoppage.

questions.question: What vibration, in millimetres per second, did Samuel Osei measure on the flume pump at 60 litres per second?

chunks.quote: Samuel Osei measured the flume pump vibration at 60 litres per second: 2.3 mm/s, below the 4.5 mm/s limit.

questions.note: The 9 June minutes give 2.3 mm/s. The 4.5 mm/s in the same sentence is the limit the reading was compared with, not the measurement.

questions.question: How many of the news documents (the news items and the letters to the editor) mention Harbour Street by name?

chunks.quote: Maria Lopez has opened a bakery at 14 Harbour Street
Harbour Street resurfacing, carried over from 2025: 110,000 pounds
move them ahead of the Harbour Street resurfacing
the resurfacing of Harbour Street was promised for this year

questions.note: One document per evidence line: the bakery item, the two budget items, the council notices, the flooding meeting item and Judith Pike's letter. The open-day item is about Harbour Station, the pumping station, and never names the street; counting it gives 7, which is wrong. Leaving out the letter because it is not a news item gives 5, also wrong: the question counts the letters. The water documents name only Harbour Station.

questions.question: Jonathan Pike received the 2023 Hensley Field-Work Award for ten years of bog monitoring. Going by his start year in the staff records, how many years had he been at the institute in 2023?

chunks.quote: 2023: Jonathan Pike (Soil Ecology), for ten years of bog monitoring.

questions.sql: SELECT 2023 - start_year FROM staff WHERE name = 'Jonathan Pike'
questions.note: The award page names the year, 2023; the staff record of Jonathan Pike (S-131), the only Pike on the staff list, gives the start year 2009: 2023 - 2009 = 14. The tempting answer is the award citation's ten years, which is the length of the bog monitoring, not of his time at the institute.
